teaching_point: Large nodular melanoma: elevated, firm, growing (EFG). NG12 1.7.3: consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for any lesion suggesting nodular melanoma, pigmented or not.
dermnet_caption: Nodular melanoma

teaching_point: Ulcerated, crusted, purple-red, rapidly growing back lesion; histology nodular melanoma. Ulceration upstages (T 'b').
dermnet_caption: An ulcerated and crusted purple-red rapidly growing lesion on the back - histology showed a nodular melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)

teaching_point: Pink nodule with peripheral dark pigment and a satellite lesion. Pigment at the edge is the clue to melanocytic origin.
dermnet_caption: A nodular lesion with a medial satelllite lesion - the larger part is pink with dark brown and black speckles suggesting an amelanotic nodular malignant melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — A nodular lesion with a medial satelllite lesion - the larger part is pink with dark brown and black speckles suggesting an amelanotic nodular malignant melanoma (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/nodular-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Ulcerated exophytic nodular melanoma. Thick tumours like this carry poor prognosis; NICE NG14 staging CT applies at stage IIC and above.
dermnet_caption: Ulcerated nodular melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Ulcerated nodular melanoma (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/nodular-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Amelanotic nodular melanoma on the ear: a pink, smooth nodule easily mistaken for PG or BCC. Nodular melanoma often fails ABCD; use EFG.
dermnet_caption: Amelanotic nodular melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Amelanotic nodular melanoma (© Raimo Suhonen) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/nodular-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Dermoscopy of nodular melanoma: blue-black structureless areas, blue-white veil, irregular vessels.
dermnet_caption: Dermoscopy of nodular melanoma

teaching_point: Dermoscopy: pink lesion with polymorphous/atypical vessels and peripheral pigment speckles.
dermnet_caption: Dermoscopy shows a pink lesion with atypical vessels and speckles of pigment peripherally - it was an 8.3 mm Breslow thickness malignant melanoma

teaching_point: A = Asymmetry of shape, structure and colour.

teaching_point: C = Colour variation. 'Irregular colour' scores 2 points in the 7-point checklist.

teaching_point: E = Evolving: the lesion in 2012 (small, fairly uniform).

teaching_point: The same lesion in 2017: larger and darker. 'Change in size' is a 2-point major feature; patient or partner report counts. Serial photos document change.

teaching_point: Superficial spreading melanoma with multiple notches and irregular pigment. Suspected cancer pathway or teledermatology with dermoscopic images, then excision biopsy (2 mm margins).
dermnet_caption: Multiple areas of notching of the border of this ugly duckling lesion - a malignant melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Multiple areas of notching of the border of this ugly duckling lesion - a malignant melanoma (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/superficial-spreading-melanoma-images

teaching_point: A changing unusual mole on the shoulder: the 'ugly duckling' sign (the lesion looks different from all the patient's other moles).
dermnet_caption: A changing unusual mole on the left shoulder - the 'ugly duckling' sign of melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — A changing unusual mole on the left shoulder - the 'ugly duckling' sign of melanoma (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/nodular-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Dermoscopy of SSM: irregular edge and pigment, atypical network, regression structures.
dermnet_caption: Dermoscopy of a superficial spreading malignant melanoma - irregular edge and pigmentation and a blue-grey veil
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)

teaching_point: Changing irregular pigmented lesion with a new nodule at one pole: vertical growth phase. Breslow thickness, and therefore stage, is increasing; urgent.
dermnet_caption: A changing irregularly pigmented lesion with a new nodule at the inferior pole - a malignant melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — A changing irregularly pigmented lesion with a new nodule at the inferior pole - a malignant melanoma (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/superficial-spreading-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Lentigo maligna (melanoma in situ) on the cheek: slowly enlarging, irregular brown macule on chronically sun-damaged skin of an older adult. DDx solar lentigo and flat SK.
dermnet_caption: Lentigo maligna
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Lentigo maligna (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/lentigo-maligna-and-lentigo-maligna-melanoma

teaching_point: Lentigo maligna with a dark raised component. A palpable or darker area within LM suggests invasion (lentigo maligna melanoma).
dermnet_caption: Lentigo maligna
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)

teaching_point: Acral lentiginous melanoma on the heel, slowly enlarging over 3 years. Often dismissed as a bruise, wart or 'stain'. It is the commonest subtype in darker skin types.
dermnet_caption: Slowly enlarging irregularly pigmented lesion on the heel present for 3 years
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Slowly enlarging irregularly pigmented lesion on the heel present for 3 years (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/acral-lentiginous-melanoma

teaching_point: Advanced acral lentiginous melanoma on the heel in skin of colour. Late presentation drives poorer survival, so check soles and nails.
dermnet_caption: An advanced acral lentiginous melanoma in skin of colour on the heel
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — An advanced acral lentiginous melanoma in skin of colour on the heel (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/acral-lentiginous-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Dermoscopy: parallel-ridge pattern (pigment on the ridges), the acral melanoma pattern. Benign acral naevi show a parallel-furrow pattern.
dermnet_caption: Parallel ridge pattern, asymmetrical structure and diffuse pigmentation
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Parallel ridge pattern, asymmetrical structure and diffuse pigmentation (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/acral-lentiginous-melanoma-images

teaching_point: Amelanotic melanoma: an irregular red lesion on the arm. Any new, growing, pink lesion that does not behave like eczema, PG or BCC needs referral.
dermnet_caption: An irregularly marginated red lesion on the arm - an amelanotic melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — An irregularly marginated red lesion on the arm - an amelanotic melanoma (© Te Whatu Ora) — https://dermnetnz.org/images/amelanotic-melanoma-images

teaching_point: In-transit metastases from a primary melanoma on the foot: multiple dark dermal nodules between the primary site and the regional nodes (stage III).
dermnet_caption: In transit metastases from primary melanoma on foot
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — In transit metastases from primary melanoma on foot (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/metastatic-melanoma

teaching_point: Nodal melanoma in the groin. A new lump in the regional node basin of a patient with past melanoma means urgent referral back to the skin cancer team.
dermnet_caption: Nodal melanoma

teaching_point: Multiple blue-grey nodules of cutaneous metastatic melanoma. Systemic immunotherapy (anti-PD-1 ± anti-CTLA-4) or BRAF/MEK targeted therapy is specialist-led; the IP role is spotting immune-related adverse effects.
dermnet_caption: Multiple blue nodules of cutaneous metastatic malignant melanoma
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Multiple blue nodules of cutaneous metastatic malignant melanoma (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/melanoma

teaching_point: Persistent blue tattoo at a sentinel node biopsy site (patent blue dye). It is harmless; reassure. SLNB is offered from Breslow over 1.0 mm (or 0.8–1.0 mm with risk factors) under NG14 2022.
dermnet_caption: Sentinel node biopsy persistent tattoo
